verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭੇਟਤ ਅਧਾਨ ਨਿਰਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise pria bheTat adhaan niramaan hot baa(n)chhat bidhaan khaan paan agrabhaag hai ||

en.bdb: As a wife presents herself to her husband with humility and becomes pregnant, the husband brings her all the foods of her liking and taste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਤ ਹਿਤ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਕਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: janamat sut khaan paan ko sa(n)jam karai sut hit ras kas sakal tiaag hai ||

en.bdb: On birth of a son, she abstains from eating all that may be harmful to the child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan saran kaamanaa pujai naam nihakaam dhaam anat na laag hai ||

en.bdb: Similarly taking the refuge of the True Guru with devotion; the desires of a Gursikh are fulfilled. He is blessed with the Naam by the True-Guru which is the source of desirelessness. One craves for nothing more and observes no rituals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਹੀ ਸੁਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੯॥
verses.translit_en: nis a(n)dhakaar bhav saagar sa(n)saar bikhai pa(n)ch tasakar jeet sikh hee sujaag hai ||179||

en.bdb: A Sikh who has received the boon of elixir-like Naam can win over the five evils cautiously and swims across worldly ocean that is frightening like a dark night. (179)
